# Song of Songs Chapter 2 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 412v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/SNG_002_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**2:1** I [am] a-rose [chavatstselet] of-the-Sharon [ha-Sharon], a-lily [shoshannat] of-the-valleys [ha-amaqim].

**2:4** He-brought-me [hevi'ani] to the-house [beit] of-wine [ha-yayin], and-his-banner [vediglo] over-me [alai] [was] love [ahavah].

**2:7** I-adjure-you [hishba'ti etkhem], O-daughters of-Yerushalayim, by-the-gazelles [bi-tseva'ot] or by-the-does [be-ailot] of-the-field [ha-sadeh]: do-not arouse [al-ta'iru] and-do-not awaken [ve'al-te'oreru] love [ha-ahavah] until [ad] it-pleases [she-techpats].

**2:10** My-beloved [dodi] spoke [anah] and-said to-me, "Arise [qumi], my-darling [ra'ayati], my-beautiful-one [yafati], and-come-away [u-lekhi-lakh]."

**2:16** My-beloved [dodi] [is] mine [li] and-I [am] his [lo]; the-one-who-pastures [ha-ro'eh] among-the-lilies [ba-shoshannim].

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Song of Songs 2 — the most explicitly erotic text in the biblical canon. The council reads it as love poetry first, without imposing allegorical frameworks (YHWH-Israel, Christ-Church) that, while historically important, are not intrinsic to the Hebrew text.

---
## Disagreement Log

Minor register variations resolved through standard consensus process.

---
*— SOPHIA, in council with EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA*
